  origin : Option Nat
  footprint : List Nat
  holder : Holder
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Dynamic pinning obligation (§74, §75): the place `pin` was applied to, the leaves it pins, and
whether it is still active. Its identity is its index in `S3.pins`. -/
structure PinOb where
  place : Nat
  leaves : List Nat
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State `S3` (§38). `F`, `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` are the components of §38. `nF` (next fresh frame
identity, §39), `dead` (death marker of places, §40) and `pins` (dynamic pinning obligations,
§74, §75) are auxiliary information that creates no right (§38). -/
structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (§74): an active pinning obligation covers it. -/
def S3.pin (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Bool := s.pins.any fun o => o.active && o.leaves.contains l

/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
receiving the shape. -/
abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)

/-- External contract `K` (§48, §80): `DeclaredDisjoint` on regions (§23, §61.3);
`SharedMutable` and `Pinned` on leaves (§68.1, §63.5); `ExternalDone` on dynamic pinning
obligations, by identity (§75); `Deallocable` on places (§70.2); `FreeCompat place auth` (§70.2);
`Satisfiable provider shape s` (§71). Obligations of `K` are hypotheses of theorems, never
fields. -/
structure K where
  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
  Pinned : Nat → Prop
  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
  Satisfiable : Nat → LocalShape → S3 → Prop

/-- `DDSound(K)` (§80, §23): no declared disjointness relates two regions sharing a leaf. -/
def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'

/-- `origin` link of authority `i` (§42). -/
def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)

/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along its origin chain (§42, §43). -/
def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i

/-- Effective anchor of `x` (§44): the root reached along its origin chain, the last element of
`x :: s.ancs x`. -/
def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x

/-- Active authority (§42); as an anchor, a valid anchor (§44). -/
def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true

/-- Decidability of `S3.Active` (§42, §44). -/
instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
  match h : s.A[x]? with
  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'

/-- Current frame, the top of the stack (§39). -/
def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0

§67.3, §68.3). -/
def DepsValid (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, partOf s.P p q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- Decidability of `DepsValid` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (DepsValid s p) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- The frame of the effective anchor of `x` (the frame of its holder) exists and is `fd` or an
ancestor of `fd` (§44). -/
def EffAnchorOK (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False

/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOK` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance

/-- `AnchorOrder` (§44, §54): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, the frame of the
effective anchor of `x` is the frame of `q` or an ancestor. -/
def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for §44). -/
theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrder` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrder s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrder_iff.symm

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54): the rule of `AnchorOrder` for every active authority held by a
usable place `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure for
§44). -/
theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
  constructor
  · intro h q _ hq x _
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject

/-! ## O15 `pin`, O16 `unpin` (§74, §75) -/

/-- Preconditions of `pin` (§74). "Applicable pinning obligations" is not represented. -/
structure PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §74: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §74: exercisable `Modify` over the leaves of `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `pin` (§74). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (PinPre s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `pin` (§74, `ok` effect): an active dynamic pinning obligation of fresh identity
`|pins|` is installed on the leaves of `place`. -/
def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins ++ [⟨p, footprint s.P p, true⟩] }

/-- `pin` as a relation (§74). -/
def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p)

/-- Effect of `unpin` (§75, `ok` effect): the designated obligation `o` ends, and only that
one. -/
def unpinEff (s : S3) (o : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins.modify o fun ob => { ob with active := false } }

/-- Preconditions of `unpin o` (§75), `o` the identity of a dynamic pinning obligation. -/
structure UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (o : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §75: `unpin` designates an active dynamic pinning obligation. -/
  active : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False
  /-- §75: `place`, on which the obligation was installed by `pin`, is usable. -/
  usable : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False
  /-- §75: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False
  /-- §75: `K.ExternalDone`, applied to the obligation. -/
  externalDone : k.ExternalDone o

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (o : Nat) :
    Decidable (UnpinPre k s o) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False ∧ k.ExternalDone o)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- `unpin` as a relation (§75). -/
def UnpinStep (k : K) (o : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (UnpinPre k s o) (unpinEff s o)
/-! ## Dynamic pinning obligations (§74, §75) -/

/-- Leaf `l` is dynamically pinned exactly when an active obligation, of some identity `i`, covers
it (§74). -/
theorem S3.pin_iff {s : S3} {l : Nat} : s.pin l = true ↔
    ∃ (i : Nat) (ob : PinOb), s.pins[i]? = some ob ∧ ob.active = true ∧ l ∈ ob.leaves := by
  simp only [S3.pin, List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, List.contains_iff_mem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ob, hob, ha, hl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem?.1 hob
    exact ⟨i, ob, hi, ha, hl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, ob, hi, ha, hl⟩; exact ⟨ob, List.mem_iff_getElem?.2 ⟨i, hi⟩, ha, hl⟩

structure ArenaInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
  /-- §55, item 1: `storage` designates an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable E.storage
  /-- §55, item 1: the footprint of `internal` is exactly the footprint of `storage`. -/
  fpEq : ∀ l, l ∈ s.afp E.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` is active. -/
  active : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` has own mode `Modify` and is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  shape : OptP (s.A[E.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §55, item 3: available leaves belong to the administered storage. -/
  availableIn : ∀ l ∈ E.available, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 3: issued regions belong to the administered storage. -/
  issuedIn : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 4: two still-active issuances have disjoint regions. -/
  disjoint : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ e' ∈ E.issued, e ≠ e' → s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 →
    ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1
  /-- §55, item 4: no leaf of a still-issued region belongs to `available`. -/
  notAvailable : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ E.available
  /-- §55, item 5: every still-issued block authority is a derivative of `internal`. -/
  derived : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → E.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2

/-- Shape of the issued blocks (support for §55, item 5, from the `ok` effect of §77; not a clause
of `ArenaInv`): every issued block authority exists, has direct origin `internal`, a fresh identity
above it, its region as footprint and mode `Modify`. -/
def IssuedShape (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some E.internal ∧ E.internal < e.2 ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify

/-- The per-entry library invariant (§55): `ArenaInv` and the auxiliary `IssuedShape`. -/
def EntryInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := ArenaInv s E ∧ IssuedShape s E

/-- The library invariant (§55, §46): every registered `internal` exists, and every live entry
satisfies `EntryInv`. -/
def LInv (L : LState) : Prop :=
  ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, E.internal < L.kern.A.length ∧ (Live L.kern E → EntryInv L.kern E)

/-! ## O17 `newArena` (§76) and the guard of §56 -/

/-- All leaves of the place holding an authority are `Init` (§76.5); vacuous for a frame. -/
def LeavesInit (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .place v => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P v, s.I l = .init
  | .frame _ => True

/-- Decidability of `LeavesInit` (§76.5). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (LeavesInit s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold LeavesInit <;> infer_instance

/-- The unified administration guard (§56, §76.4) as a contract predicate: `internal` is absent
from every registry of live administrations. A registry is given by the `internal` identities of
its live administrations; `regs` lists all relevant registries. -/
def Guard56 (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Prop := ∀ R ∈ regs, i ∉ R

/-- Decidability of `Guard56` (§56). -/
instance (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Decidable (Guard56 regs i) := by
  unfold Guard56; infer_instance

/-- The arena registry as a registry of live administrations (§46, §56): the `internal`
identities of its live entries. -/
def liveInternals (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) : List Nat :=
  (arenas.filter fun E => decide (s.Active E.internal)).map (·.internal)

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` other than the guard (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5).
§76.6 is a precondition of §76 and is omitted here pending arbitration, since it has two readings:
global (`NewArena766Global`: `WF3`, `I1`, `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` of the state, and
`ArenaInv` of every live entry) and local (`NewArena766Local`: their clauses at the storage, the
arena value and `internal`, and `ArenaInv` of the new entry). Both hold when this structure holds
on a `KInv` state (`newArena766Local_of_kinv`; `newArena766Global_of_kinv`, with `LInv`), but not on
library-reachable states outside `KInv` (the §63 cycle): the model accepts `newArena` where the
global reading fails and the local one holds (`Witness.newArena766_global_fails_local_holds`), and
where both fail (`Witness.newArena766_local_fails`). -/
structure NewArenaBase (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable storage
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. -/
  storageRight : HasRight s .modify storage
  /-- §76.2: `internal` exists, is active and has own mode `Modify`. -/
  internalAuth : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False
  /-- §76.2: `ExercisableAt(s, internal, Modify)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt internal .modify
  /-- §76.3: `internal` is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  heldByPlace : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(internal) ⊆ footprint(storage)`. -/
  fpSub : ∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(storage) ⊆ footprint(internal)`. -/
  fpSup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal
  /-- §76.5: all leaves of the arena value are already `Init`. -/
  valueInit : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaBase` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaBase s storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable storage ∧ HasRight s .modify storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76): those of `NewArenaBase` and the guard of
§76.4 over the arena registry and the other registries `others` (§56). -/
structure NewArenaPre (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat))
    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5. -/
  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
  /-- §76.4, §56: no live administration of any relevant registry uses `internal`. -/
  guard : Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaPre` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
    Decidable (NewArenaPre s arenas others storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
    Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `newArena` (§76, `ok` effect): a live entry is added, `available` holding the leaves
of the storage and `issued` empty; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
def newArenaEff (L : LState) (storage internal : Nat) : LState :=
  { L with arenas := L.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint L.kern.P storage, []⟩] }

/-- `newArena` as a relation (§76, §58): `ok` or `reject`; `others` are the other registries of
live administrations consulted by the guard (§56). -/
def NewArenaStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas others storage internal) (newArenaEff L storage internal)

/-! ## O18 `issue` (§77) -/

  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →

/-! ## O19 `reset` (§78) -/

/-- §78.3: no still-usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of
`internal`. Dependencies of contained values are covered since parts are places. -/
def ResetNoDeps (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, E.internal ∉ s.ancs x

/-- Decidability of `ResetNoDeps` (§78.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetNoDeps s E) := by
  unfold ResetNoDeps; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `reset(arena)` (§78). "`internal` and the arena's other restrictions remain
valid" (§78.1) and "validity obligations of other nested arenas remain satisfied" (§78.3) name no
checkable condition beyond `ArenaInv` and are not represented. -/
structure ResetPre (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
  /-- §78.1: the entry is live. -/
  live : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §78.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
  metaRight : MetaRight s E
  /-- §78.2: no active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the storage. -/
  noCover : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
    ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §78.3: no usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of `internal`. -/
  noDeps : ResetNoDeps s E

/-- Decidability of `ResetPre` (§78). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetPre s E) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
      ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ ResetNoDeps s E)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- Kernel part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, Part XIV): the record of the `Modify`
derivation of `internal` over all the storage, already released; no leaf becomes `Init`. -/

# Refinement of the derived arena operations into the memory machine (spec v0.1, §82.7)

Source: `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, §82.7 with Part XIV (§76–§78), the §82
preamble, §82.2–§82.5 and §86.

* Library operations (`LOp`) and their `ok` steps (`LOpStep`): the kernel operations O1–O16 and
  the derived arena operations O17–O19 of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena`.
* The kernel steps realizing a library step (`kexp`, `kexp_path`, Part XIV): none for `newArena`,
  `split` then `store` for `issue`, `derive` then `release` for `reset`. The raw operations of a
  library step (`lopsOf`) are the raw operations of these kernel steps (`ktrace`).
* Per derived operation: realization, reads, writes and lifetimes (`arena_newArena`,
  `arena_issue`, `arena_reset`, `reset_split`, `issue_pointer_sound`); the bytes of an issued
  region are unchanged by the realization of `issue` (`issue_keeps_bytes`, §86). Theorems with
  invariant hypotheses on their pre-state have a `_reachable` corollary without them (§57).
* Library runs translated into the memory machine with parameters fixed once per run
  (`LSimRun`), with no invariant hypothesis: every such run is a kernel simulation run
  (`LSimRun.simRun`); `lsimulation`.
* §82.7: the machine trace of a library run is the trace of its kernel steps, and no kernel step
  after a legal `reset` uses an authority that the `reset` invalidated (`arena_realized`).

The sequential fragment only (§18, §29): no theorem here says anything about concurrency.
-/

modifies no byte of the issued region, so a reissued leaf keeps its bytes. Its raw operations are
one write of the range of the destination (`arena_issue`), a leaf that is not in the region
(§77.2); under the layout interface (§82.1, §23, part of `Repr`), the range of every leaf of the
region is in another allocation or disjoint from it. No invariant hypothesis. -/
theorem issue_keeps_bytes {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat}
    {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2) (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L')) :
    ∀ l ∈ region, ∀ n < (π.L l).len,
      bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L l n = bytesOf s2 π.L l n := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hsta _ _ _ =>
  intro l hl n hn
  rw [issue_ops hE]
  simp only [storeOps, writeOps, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, run, opEff]
  obtain ⟨hlP, hlf, -⟩ := mem_footprint.1 (hsta.regionIn l hl)
  have hne : dst ≠ l := fun h => hsta.dstNotIn (h ▸ hl)
  refine bytesOf_write_disjoint ?_ hn
  by_cases e : (π.L dst).alloc = (π.L l).alloc
  · exact .inr (hR.layout.disjoint dst l hsta.dstUsable.lt hlP hsta.dstLeaf hlf hne e)
  · exact .inl e

/-- The issued region and the memory machine (§82.7, §82.3, §77): after an `ok` issue, under
`Repr`, `WF3` and `NoDangling`, the address `ad` of the reference to the block and the obligation
of the encoding for it (the pointer-size rule and `PtrEncAt`, hypotheses of
`pointer_sound_store`), the range of the destination decodes to `ad`, each of its bytes carries the
provenance of the allocation of the block's effective anchor, and every leaf of the region lies in
that allocation, live and containing the range of the leaf. -/
theorem issue_pointer_sound {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat}
    {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry} {s2 : Machine.State} {ad : Nat}
    (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2) (hw : WF3 L.kern)
    (hnd : NoDangling L.kern) (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L'))
    (had : ptrAddr s2 π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length = ad)
    (hsz : (π.L dst).len = π.pe.size)
    (henc : PtrEncAt π.pe ad
      (some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length))) :
    π.pe.decode (bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L dst) = ad ∧
    (∀ n, n < (π.L dst).len → (bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L dst n).2 =
      some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)) ∧
    ∀ l ∈ region,
      (π.L l).alloc = anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length ∧
      AllocP s2 (π.L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (π.L l).off + (π.L l).len ≤ al.size := by
  rw [issue_ops hE]
  cases hs with
  | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' _ _ hsp hst =>
  rw [hE] at hE'
  cases hE'
  have e₁ := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).2
  subst e₁
  have h := pointer_sound_store (Ty := Ty) (ty := π.ty) (r6_split hR hsp)
    (split_preserves_wf3 hw hsp) (split_preserves_noDangling hnd hsp) hst had hsz henc
  have hafp : (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]).afp L.kern.A.length = region := by
    simp [S3.afp, split_block]
  exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, fun l hl => h.2.2.1 l (by rw [hafp]; exact hl)⟩

/-- `issue_pointer_sound` on library-reachable states (§82.7, §82.3, §77, §57): without invariant
hypothesis, under `DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
theorem issue_pointer_sound_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty}
    {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    {s2 : Machine.State} {ad : Nat} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hL : LReach k statics L) (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E)
    (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2) (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L'))
    (had : ptrAddr s2 π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length = ad)
    (hsz : (π.L dst).len = π.pe.size)
    (henc : PtrEncAt π.pe ad
      (some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length))) :
    π.pe.decode (bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L dst) = ad ∧
    (∀ n, n < (π.L dst).len → (bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L dst n).2 =
      some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)) ∧
    ∀ l ∈ region,
      (π.L l).alloc = anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length ∧
      AllocP s2 (π.L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (π.L l).off + (π.L l).len ≤ al.size :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hL.ng.reachable
  issue_pointer_sound hE hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 hs had hsz henc

content.content:
/-- The `ok` effect of the derived `issue` of entry `i` (§77): the kernel state is `issueKEff`
(`issueKEff_eq`); the entry becomes `issueMeta`, earlier issuances kept; former authorities are
unchanged; only leaf `destination` changes initialization and only its anchors change. -/
theorem issue_effect {k : K} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    {E : ArenaEntry} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L')) :
    L'.kern = issueKEff L.kern E region dst ∧
    L'.arenas[i]? = some (issueMeta L.kern E region) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, e ∈ (issueMeta L.kern E region).issued) ∧
    (∀ x < L.kern.A.length, L'.kern.A[x]? = L.kern.A[x]?) ∧
    (∀ l, l ≠ dst → L'.kern.I l = L.kern.I l) ∧ L'.kern.I dst = .init ∧
    ∀ q, q ≠ dst → L'.kern.D q = L.kern.D q := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' _ _ hsp hsto =>
  rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsto
  rw [← issueKEff_eq]
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, fun e he => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he, fun x hx => ?_, fun l hl => ?_, ?_,
    fun q hq => ?_⟩
  · simp only [List.getElem?_set, lt_of_getElem? hE, ↓reduceIte]
  · exact List.getElem?_append_left hx
  · simp [issueKEff, hl]
  · simp [issueKEff]
  · simp [issueKEff, hq]

/-- v0.1 §86 (initialization state): an accepted derived `issue` leaves the initialization state of
every leaf of the issued region unchanged, so a reissued leaf keeps its initialization state. Only
leaf `destination` becomes `Init` (§77 `ok` effect), and it is not in the region (§77.2). -/
theorem issue_keeps_init {k : K} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L')) : ∀ l ∈ region, L'.kern.I l = L.kern.I l := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hst _ hsp hsto =>
    intro l hl
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsto
    rw [← issueKEff_eq]
    have hne : l ≠ dst := fun h => hst.dstNotIn (h ▸ hl)
    simp [issueKEff, hne]

/-- v0.1 §86 (initialization state) for the contract of `issue` (§77): an `ok` leaves the
initialization state of every leaf of the issued region unchanged. -/
theorem issueC_keeps_init {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    (hs : IssueC i region dst L (.ok L')) : ∀ l ∈ region, L'.kern.I l = L.kern.I l := by
  cases hs with
  | ok _ hst _ _ _ =>
    intro l hl
    have hne : l ≠ dst := fun h => hst.dstNotIn (h ▸ hl)
    simp [issueL, issueKEff, hne]

/-- The `ok` effect of the derived `reset` of entry `i` (§78): the kernel state is `resetKEff`
(`resetKEff_eq`), which adds only an inactive record: places, initialization ("no leaf is made
`Init` by `reset`"), anchors, and former authorities are unchanged; the entry becomes
`resetMeta`, all leaves of the storage available and `issued` cleared. -/
theorem reset_effect {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E)
    (hs : ResetD i L (.ok L')) :
    L'.kern = resetKEff L.kern E ∧ L'.arenas[i]? = some (resetMeta L.kern E) ∧
    L'.kern.P = L.kern.P ∧ L'.kern.I = L.kern.I ∧ L'.kern.D = L.kern.D ∧
    (∀ x < L.kern.A.length, L'.kern.A[x]? = L.kern.A[x]?) ∧
    ¬ L'.kern.Active L.kern.A.length := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' hd hrl _ =>
  rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl
  rw [← resetKEff_eq]
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, fun x hx => List.getElem?_append_left hx, ?_⟩
  · simp only [List.getElem?_set, lt_of_getElem? hE, ↓reduceIte]
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
    simp [resetKEff] at hy; rw [← hy] at ya; cases ya

/-- §88, §77.2: `issue` into a leaf of the issued region is rejected, by a static check, even
when the region is unavailable (no `fail`). -/
theorem issue_into_region_rejected {L : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    {o : Outcome3 LState} (hd : dst ∈ region) (h : IssueC i region dst L o) : o = .reject := by
  cases h with
  | noEntry => rfl
  | static => rfl
  | fail _ hs => exact absurd hd hs.dstNotIn
  | noRight => rfl
  | noArrival => rfl
  | ok _ hs => exact absurd hd hs.dstNotIn

/-- §88, §77.6 (O8.5): `issue` into a destination that would no longer be under exercisable
`Modify` in the resulting state is not `ok`. -/
theorem issue_keeps_dst {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    (h : IssueC i region dst L (.ok L')) :
    ∃ E, L.arenas[i]? = some E ∧ HasRight (issueKEff L.kern E region dst) .modify dst := by
  cases h with
  | ok hE _ _ _ ha => exact ⟨_, hE, ha.keepsDst⟩

/-! ## Library runs (Part XIV, §46, §56, §57) -/

/-- One `ok` step of a library run (Part XIV): a kernel step O1–O16 of non-administrative code,
the registry unchanged; `newArena` with the guard of §56 against the other registries `others`;
the derived `issue` or `reset`. -/
inductive LStep (k : K) : LState → LState → Prop where
namespace Witness

open Examples

/-- Initial library state (§47). -/
def w0 : LState := LState.init st
/-- `derive(1, [1], Modify)`: authority 3 on the storage leaf, held by frame 0 (§60). -/
def w1 : LState := ⟨deriveEff w0.kern 1 [1] .modify, w0.arenas⟩
/-- `store(3, 0)`: authority 3 becomes `internal`, held by the arena value 0 (§65). -/
def w2 : LState := ⟨storeEff w1.kern 3 0, w1.arenas⟩
/-- `newArena(1, 3)` (§76). -/
def w3 : LState := newArenaEff w2 1 3
/-- The entry registered by `newArena(1, 3)` (§46, §76). -/
def wE : ArenaEntry := ⟨1, 3, [1], []⟩

/-- The common prefix is library-reachable (Part XIV, §76). -/
theorem w3_reach : LReach K0 st w3 := by
  have r1 : LReach K0 st w1 := .step .init (.kernel (.derive (.ok (by decide))))
  have r2 : LReach K0 st w2 := .step r1 (.kernel (.store (.ok (by decide))))
  exact .step r2 (.newArena (others := []) (.ok (by decide)))

/-- `issue(0, [1], 2)`: `split(3, [[1]])` then `store(4, 2)` (§77). -/
def r4 : LState :=
  ⟨storeEff (splitEff w3.kern 3 [[1]]) w3.kern.A.length 2,
    w3.arenas.set 0 (issueMeta w3.kern wE [1])⟩
/-- `write(4, [1])`: the storage leaf 1 is written through block 4 (§67). -/
def r5 : LState := ⟨write3Eff r4.kern [1], r4.arenas⟩
/-- `endUse(2)`: the destination ends; block 4, held by it, is released (§69). -/
def r6 : LState := ⟨endUseEff r5.kern 2, r5.arenas⟩
/-- The entry after the first issue (§77 `ok` effect). -/
def rE : ArenaEntry := ⟨1, 3, [], [([1], 4)]⟩
/-- `reset(0)`: `derive(3, [1], Modify)`, `release(5)`, metadata restored (§78). -/
def r7 : LState :=
  ⟨releaseEff (deriveEff r6.kern 3 (footprint r6.kern.P 1) .modify) r6.kern.A.length,
    r6.arenas.set 0 (resetMeta r6.kern rE)⟩
/-- The entry after the reset (§78 `ok` effect). -/
def rE' : ArenaEntry := ⟨1, 3, [1], []⟩
/-- `issue(0, [1], 2)` again: `split(3, [[1]])` then `store(6, 2)` (§77). -/
def r8 : LState :=
  ⟨storeEff (splitEff r7.kern 3 [[1]]) r7.kern.A.length 2,
    r7.arenas.set 0 (issueMeta r7.kern rE' [1])⟩

/-- v0.1 §86, example: a reissued leaf keeps its initialization state and a read of it remains
subject to the ordinary conditions of the memory model. Leaf 1 is `Uninit` when it is first issued,
is written through block 4, keeps `Init` across `endUse` of the destination, the legal `reset`
(§78: "No leaf is made `Init` by `reset`") and the reissue, which modifies the initialization state
of no leaf of the region (§86, `issue_keeps_init`) and initializes only the destination 2 (§77).
In the final library-reachable state, `read` of leaf 1 through the new block 6 is `ok`: the leaf
is `Init` and block 6 is exercisable (§66). -/
theorem reissue_reads_former_value :
    LReach K0 st r8 ∧ KInv r8.kern ∧ KAux r8.kern ∧
    r4.kern.I 1 = .uninit ∧ r5.kern.I 1 = .init ∧ r7.kern.I 1 = .init ∧ r8.kern.I 1 = .init ∧
    ¬ r8.kern.Active 4 ∧
    (r8.kern.A[6]?).map (fun y => (y.origin, y.footprint, y.holder, y.active)) =
      some (some 3, [1], .place 2, true) ∧
    r8.arenas = [⟨1, 3, [], [([1], 6)]⟩] ∧
    Read3Step 6 [1] r8.kern (.ok r8.kern) := by
  have h4 : LReach K0 st r4 := .step w3_reach
    (.issue (i := 0) (region := [1]) (dst := 2)
      (.ok (E := wE) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))))
  have h5 : LReach K0 st r5 := .step h4 (.kernel (.write (a := 4) (.ok (by decide))))
  have h6 : LReach K0 st r6 := .step h5 (.kernel (.endUse (.ok (by decide))))
  have h7 : LReach K0 st r7 := .step h6
    (.reset (i := 0) (.ok (E := rE) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)) (by decide)))
  have h8 : LReach K0 st r8 := .step h7
    (.issue (i := 0) (region := [1]) (dst := 2)
      (.ok (E := rE') (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))))
  have hk := KInvB.sound (s := r8.kern) (by decide)
  exact ⟨h8, hk.1, hk.2, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

end Witness

end Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/

/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
      f < s.nF) ∧
    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
      o < s.P.length) ∧
    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
  root authority. -/
  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
  rootChain : RootChain s
  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
  rootHeld : RootHeld s
  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
    HolderLive s y.holder

/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/

/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
both have own mode `Observe`. -/
def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe

/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
origin's, the derived footprint is within the origin's, and the origin of an active derived
authority is valid, that is, active. -/
def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ (∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) ∧
      (y.active = true → x.active = true)

/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

/-- `I5` (§57): every pinned leaf, statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (an active pinning
obligation, §74), belongs to a usable place. The quantifier ranges over the leaves of the state
(§40): `K.Pinned` on an index that is not a leaf of `s` is not constrained. A specialized
obligation of `K.Pinned`, not a conjunct of the main invariant (§57). -/
def I5 (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ l, l < s.P.length → isLeaf s.P l → (k.Pinned l ∨ s.pin l = true) →
    ∃ q, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q

which `lInv_stepNG` asks of them. -/
theorem lReachNG_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : LState} (h : LReachNG k statics L) : LInv L := by
  induction h with

every live entry of a library-reachable state satisfies `ArenaInv` (`lReachNG_inv`). -/
theorem lReach_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : LState} (h : LReach k statics L) : ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, Live L.kern E → ArenaInv L.kern E :=
  fun E hE hl => ((lReachNG_inv hdd hst h.ng E hE).2 hl).1

(`Access.reachable_kinv`) and `ArenaInv` of the entry (`lReach_inv`) hold there. -/

    {L : LState} (hr : LReach k statics L) {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}

/-- `issue` as its kernel sequence, per step (Part XIV, §77, §58): on a state satisfying the
kernel invariant, when the entry satisfies `ArenaInv` if live, the contract of `issue` and the
derived operation (`split` then `store`) have the same outcomes, `ok`, `fail` and `reject`, with
the same arrival state, kernel part included (literal equality, `issueKEff_eq`). On
library-reachable states the hypotheses hold (`issue_as_kernel`). -/
theorem issue_as_kernel_of_inv (k : K) {L : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    (hk : KInv L.kern)

    rw [issueL, issueKEff_eq]

    | noEntry h0 => exact .noEntry h0
    | static hE hs => exact .static hE hs

    | noArrival hE hs hav hr ha =>
      have hA := hai _ hE hs.live

        (.ok ((arrival_iff_store hw hnd hA hs).1 ha))

    cases h with
    | noEntry h0 => exact .noEntry h0
    | static hE hs => exact .static hE hs
    | fail hE hs hav => exact .fail hE hs hav
    | split hE hs hav hsp =>
      exact .noRight hE hs hav fun hr =>
        Guarded.reject_iff.1 hsp ((issueRight_iff_split k (hai _ hE hs.live) hs).1 hr)
    | store hE hs hav hsp hst =>
      have hA := hai _ hE hs.live
      obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
      exact .noArrival hE hs hav ((issueRight_iff_split k hA hs).2 hp)
        fun ha => Guarded.reject_iff.1 hst ((arrival_iff_store hw hnd hA hs).1 ha)
    | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hs hav hsp hst =>

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Arenas: the reference library abstraction (Part XIV)

Arenas of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, Part XIV (§76–§78), with §36, §46, §55,
§56, §58, §79, §86 and §88. An arena is a library abstraction (Part XIV): its entries live in a
library state separate from the kernel state `S₃` (§38, §46). `newArena` (O17) only registers an
entry; `issue` (O18) and `reset` (O19) are defined twice:

* as their contracts, clause by clause (§77, §78): `IssueC`, `ResetC`;
* as derived operations over the kernel steps (Part XIV): `issue` is its static checks, the
  availability `fail`, then `split` of `internal` on the region and `store` of the block into the
  destination (`IssueD`); `reset` is `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the whole storage,
  then `release`, then the explicit check of §78.3 (`ResetD`), which never rejects after an
  accepted `derive` on states satisfying I3 (`resetNoDeps_of_derive`).

On library-reachable states, `issue_as_kernel` and `reset_as_kernel` show that both definitions
have the same outcomes and the same arrival states, and `lReach_inv` that every live entry
satisfies `ArenaInv` (§55). Library reachability (`LReach`, `LReachNG`) uses the derived
operations, so its kernel states are kernel-reachable (`newArena_as_library`) and satisfy the
kernel invariant of §57 (`Access.reachable_kinv`).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Library state (§46) -/

/-- Arena entry (§46): administered storage, `internal` authority, available leaves and issued
regions with their block authorities. The sets of §46 are lists read by membership. -/
structure ArenaEntry where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  available : List Nat
  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Library state (§46, §38): the kernel state `S₃` and, separately, the arena registry. -/
structure LState where
  kern : S3
  arenas : List ArenaEntry

/-- Initial library state (§47): the initial kernel state and an empty arena registry. -/
def LState.init (statics : Statics) : LState := ⟨S3.init statics, []⟩

/-- Live arena (§46): `internal` is active. -/
def Live (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := s.Active E.internal

/-! ## Executable runs (§58, §60–§75) -/

/-- The preconditions of the `ok` outcome of a kernel operation (§60–§75; for `alloc`, the static
preconditions and `K.Satisfiable`, §71). -/
def OpPre (k : K) : KOp → S3 → Prop
  | .derive src region m, s => DerivePre s src region m
  | .split src rs, s => SplitPre k s src rs
  | .release a, s => ReleasePre s a
  | .transfer src dst, s => TransferPre k s src dst
  | .depend q x, s => DependPre s q x
  | .enter ps ls, s => EnterPre s ps ls
  | .exit, s => ExitPre k s
  | .read a ls, s => Read3Pre s a ls
  | .write a ls _, s => Write3Pre s a ls
  | .writeShared a ls _, s => WriteSharedPre k s a ls
  | .pin p, s => PinPre s p
  | .unpin o, s => UnpinPre k s o
  | .endUse p, s => EndUsePre k s p
  | .free p auth, s => FreePre k s p auth
  | .alloc pr ow ls, s => AllocStatic k s pr ow ls ∧ k.Satisfiable pr ls s
  | .store a p, s => StorePre s a p

/-- The effect of the `ok` outcome of a kernel operation (§60–§75). -/
def opEff3 : KOp → S3 → S3
  | .derive src region m, s => deriveEff s src region m
  | .split src rs, s => splitEff s src rs
  | .release a, s => releaseEff s a
  | .transfer src dst, s => transferEff s src dst
  | .depend q x, s => dependEff s q x
  | .enter ps ls, s => enterEff s ps ls
  | .exit, s => exitEff s
  | .read _ _, s => s
  | .write _ ls _, s => write3Eff s ls
  | .writeShared _ ls _, s => write3Eff s ls
  | .pin p, s => pinEff s p
  | .unpin o, s => unpinEff s o
  | .endUse p, s => endUseEff s p
  | .free p _, s => freeEff s p
  | .alloc _ ow ls, s => allocEff s ow ls
  | .store a p, s => storeEff s a p

/-- The preconditions give the `ok` step to the effect (§58). -/
theorem opStep_of_pre {k : K} {op : KOp} {s : S3} (h : OpPre k op s) :
    OpStep k op s (opEff3 op s) := by
  cases op with
  | alloc => exact .ok h.1 h.2
  | _ => exact .ok h

section Runner

variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of a kernel operation (§60–§75). -/
instance opPreDec (op : KOp) (s : S3) : Decidable (OpPre k op s) := by
  cases op <;> unfold OpPre <;> infer_instance

variable {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel C] (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
  (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) [∀ s o, Decidable (Obl ObR ObW s o)] (π : Params Ty)

/-- Decidability of the obligations of a step (§20.3, §82). -/
instance stepOblDec (op : KOp) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) :
    Decidable (StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) := by
  unfold StepObl; cases op <;> dsimp only <;> infer_instance

/-- One translated step: when the preconditions and the obligations hold, the effect of the step
and the memory state after its raw operations (§82). -/
def sstep (st : S3 × Machine.State) (op : KOp) : Option (S3 × Machine.State) :=
  if OpPre k op st.1 ∧ StepObl k C ObR ObW π op st.1 st.2
  then some (opEff3 op st.1, run st.2 (opsOf π op st.1 st.2)) else none

/-- A translated run of a list of operations, in order (§82). -/
def srun : S3 × Machine.State → List KOp → Option (S3 × Machine.State)
  | st, [] => some st
  | st, op :: ops => (sstep k C ObR ObW π st op).bind fun st' => srun st' ops

end Runner

/-- A successful translated run extends a `SimRun` (§82 preamble). -/
theorem srun_sound {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')]
    [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone]
    [DecidablePred k.Deallocable] [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)]

## 63. O4 — Consuming Value Transfer

**Preconditions**

1. `source` and `destination` are usable, and the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over their relevant footprints.
2. Source and destination have the **same shape of ordered subtrees**. The `i`-th child of each source part corresponds to the `i`-th child of the corresponding destination part; all nodes are matched. Structural field identity is positional, not an arbitrary matching of children.
3. **All** source leaves are `Init`, and **no** destination leaf is `Init`. The source and destination footprints are disjoint.
4. No exclusive authority is duplicated; validity of derived authorities and active projections is preserved. No active derived authority held outside `source` covers a source leaf, except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `source`: the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain. Other active authorities remain subject to this check.
5. **No in-place source leaf is pinned**, either statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (`pin`). Storage merely **owned** by the source, which is not itself moved by the transfer of that value, does not prevent this transfer.
6. Dependencies of all still-usable places following the value remain valid; non-escape constraints and `AnchorOrder` are checked in the **resulting state**, including transferred anchors of owned places that remain usable.
7. All moved held authorities, including those of owned storage, satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state; no authority may escape a local anchor on the grounds that its containing value was transferred.
8. **Local self-blocking prevention:** For each active authority held before the step by a part `r` of `source` whose holder becomes the corresponding part `corr(r)` of `destination`, that authority's footprint contains **no leaf** of `corr(r)` in the resulting state. Transfer is rejected if this local check fails; no global authority-acyclicity check is imposed.
9. **Destination usability:** `destination` is usable in the resulting state.

**`ok` effect:**

- every source leaf becomes `Moved` and each corresponding destination leaf becomes `Init`;
- every authority held by source part `r` acquires as its new holder the corresponding destination part `corr(r)`, not indiscriminately the destination root;
- places owned by `r` become owned by `corr(r)`; their roots follow this owner according to `RootHeld`;
- value dependencies follow the corresponding places under validity guarantees; no authority is created or duplicated;
- destination places receive the transferred values and rights without automatically moving storage not owned by a source part.

**Other outcome:** `reject`. `transfer` to a call result is subject to these same rules.

A partially initialized structure may be transferred **field by field**, but only for fields individually eligible for transfer. This does not automatically destructure a value that owns storage **at the container level**: that storage stays with the container if the container is not transferred. Conversion between structures with permuted fields must be handled separately, not as a `transfer`.

## 69. O12 — Logical End of a Value's Use

**Preconditions**

1. `place` is usable and the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over it.
2. No active descendant over the leaves of `place` **or storage that dies with it** is held outside the places dying with `place`, in a way that would prevent rights from returning or being invalidated. The authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`, namely the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain, are exempt from this check. Moreover, no authority that the effect makes inactive (held by `place` or by a place dying with it, transitively owned storage included) has an active descendant, whatever its footprint, that the same step does not make inactive.
3. No place **remaining usable after the effect** depends on an authority held by `place`, its root, or an authority that would become inactive when an owned holder dies.
4. **No leaf whose use ends, including transitively owned storage, is pinned**, either statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (`pin`). A dynamic pinning obligation must be legally removed by `unpin` before this step.

**`ok` effect:** The leaves of value `place` become `Uninit`; `place` **remains usable as a place** and may legally be reinitialized. Authorities held by `place` and dead substorages are released; dependencies of the ended value are removed; transitively owned places that cease to live are marked dead. The operation does not automatically trigger physical deallocation in the elementary memory machine: an unfreed allocation may constitute a leak, which this guarantee does not prohibit. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 70. O13 — Release of an Owned Storage Unit

**Preconditions**

1. `place` is a **root of storage owned by a value** (`OwnedRoot`), not an ordinary local directly owned by a frame and not part of an aggregate.
2. `K.Deallocable(place)` is established, and `K.FreeCompat(place,auth)` justifies deallocation authority `auth`; this identifier is opaque to the authority kernel.
3. The current frame has exercisable `Modify`; no active derivative over the footprint being freed is held outside holders that die; no surviving place is anchored to an authority of the released region or of its dead holders. The authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`, namely the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain, are exempt from the check on active derivatives. Moreover, no authority that the effect makes inactive (an authority of the released region, its root included, or an authority whose holder dies) has an active descendant, whatever its footprint, that the same step does not make inactive.
4. No leaf of the released unit is statically or dynamically pinned. Ending external use does not silently turn a still-pinned leaf into a releasable unit.

**`ok` effect:** `place` and the storage that ceases to live are marked dead; authorities of those regions, including their corresponding roots, become inactive, as do authorities whose holders die. Surviving dependencies must remain valid. Every realization of `free` must satisfy the corresponding deallocation relation of the elementary memory machine (Part III). **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 71. O14 — Allocation of a New Storage Root

**Static preconditions**

1. `shape` is a **nonempty** abstract shape, represented like the local places of `enterFrame`; an allocation of **zero physical size** may be represented by a logical one-leaf shape.
2. The provider is a usable place, and **all leaves of the provider** are `Init`; updates to its metadata are permitted through exercisable `Modify` or a valid `writeShared` over `SharedMutable` metadata.
3. The current frame has exercisable `Modify` over `owner`; new identities and ownership relations must respect `WF3`, `RootHeld`, and liveness restrictions.

**Outcomes**

- `reject`: a static precondition does not hold;
- `fail`: static preconditions hold, but `K.Satisfiable(provider,shape,s)` is false in the state under consideration; **no state change**;
- `ok(s')`: creation of a **new storage root** with fresh identity, owned by `owner`; its leaves start `Uninit`, its new root `Modify` authority with no origin is held by `owner`; provider metadata is updated only in accordance with its modification rights.

Allocation success depends on the provider's state: it does not constitute a right to invent physical memory. Any realization of this operation must satisfy the `AllocStep` relation defined by the rules of Sections 9 and 13.

# XII. Call Frames and Return of Authorities

Frames are execution units that receive authorities, introduce locals, and have exit rules distinct from Spec 3's value-passing conventions.

## 72. O6 — Entering a Frame

**Preconditions**

1. The calling frame is the current frame and is live. Each parameter passed to the callee is an active, derived authority held by the caller before the step; the caller is **not necessarily** the frame in which the authority was first derived.
2. Modes, footprints, anchoring, and parameter-passing rules permit this change of holder; introduction of locals preserves well-formedness and the validity of their roots.
3. **Origin protection on entry:** for each `Modify` parameter with direct origin `o`, `o` is exercisable in **no mode** (neither `Observe` nor `Modify`) in the **resulting state**, once the new frame's parameters and locals have been created.
4. **G4:** `AnchorOrderHeld` is checked over the complete resulting state.

**`ok` effect:** A new child frame is pushed onto the stack; active parameters **are yielded** to that frame, which becomes their sole holder; local places and their root authorities are created; valid anchors inherited from the caller are preserved. This transfer creates no additional rights. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

This clause establishes **entry protection**. It does not prove the stronger property of protection throughout the **entire** invocation following other releases or reanchorings. While a `Modify` parameter remains active, its direct origin remains subject to effective-mode restrictions. Any additional protection throughout the invocation is deferred to Spec 3.

## 73. O7 — Exiting a Frame

**Preconditions**

1. The current frame is not the initial frame and has a surviving caller.
2. Results that must survive have already been legally transferred to their destinations; no active authority or dependency may remain invalidly attached to locals that are about to die.
3. **No leaf of a place that dies with the frame, including transitively owned storage, is pinned**, either statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (`pin`).
4. Iterated reanchoring of surviving authorities and anchors reaches the **first surviving active origin**, held either by a surviving frame or by a usable place whose terminal owner survives; it is not permitted to skip a surviving origin merely because it is held by a place. The operation is rejected when no suitable surviving origin exists, particularly if the chain reaches a root of the exiting frame.
5. Validity of anchors of surviving values and `AnchorOrderHeld` are checked **in the resulting state**. Other state invariants and resource contracts are respected.

**`ok` effect:**

- the current frame is removed from the stack; its untransferred locals and substorages dying with them become unusable;
- authorities still held by that frame, or by places that have become unusable, are released;
- origins of surviving derived authorities are reanchored to the **first surviving active origin** of their chains, whether held by a frame or a usable place, and the `D` anchors of surviving values are correspondingly reanchored;
- reanchoring changes **neither the footprint nor the own mode** of an authority; parameter identities and relations specific to the frame cease their operational role;
- the calling frame becomes current again.

**Other outcome:** `reject`. Exiting does not entail automatic physical deallocation of all dead places. Deferred cleanup (`defer`) lies outside this kernel. Reanchoring may change the current `origin` relation; protection of a historical borrow lineage during an invocation is a distinct, deferred question.

/-! ## Sequences of raw operations (§20.1, §20.3) -/

section Seq

/-- One `ok` step of a library run (Part XIV): a kernel step O1–O16 of non-administrative code,
the registry unchanged; `newArena` with the guard of §56 against the other registries `others`;
the derived `issue` or `reset`. -/
inductive LStep (k : K) : LState → LState → Prop where
  | kernel {L : LState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → LStep k L ⟨s', L.arenas⟩
  | newArena {L L' : LState} {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} :
      NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L') → LStep k L L'
  | issue {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} :
      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') → LStep k L L'
  | reset {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} : ResetD i L (.ok L') → LStep k L L'

/-- One `ok` step of a library run in which `newArena` registers without the guard of §56
(§76.4 removed, the other preconditions of §76 kept). -/
inductive LStepNG (k : K) : LState → LState → Prop where
  | kernel {L : LState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → LStepNG k L ⟨s', L.arenas⟩
  | newArena {L : LState} {st i : Nat} : NewArenaBase L.kern st i →
      LStepNG k L (newArenaEff L st i)
  | issue {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} :
      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') → LStepNG k L L'
  | reset {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} : ResetD i L (.ok L') → LStepNG k L L'

/-- Library states reachable from the initial library state (§47) by library steps (Part
XIV). -/
inductive LReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : LState → Prop where
  | init : LReach k statics (LState.init statics)
  | step {L L' : LState} : LReach k statics L → LStep k L L' → LReach k statics L'

/-- Library states reachable when `newArena` registers without the guard of §56. -/
inductive LReachNG (k : K) (statics : Statics) : LState → Prop where
  | init : LReachNG k statics (LState.init statics)
  | step {L L' : LState} : LReachNG k statics L → LStepNG k L L' → LReachNG k statics L'

/-- Finite sequences of library steps (Part XIV, §46). -/
inductive LRun (k : K) : LState → LState → Prop where
  | refl (L : LState) : LRun k L L
  | tail {L L' L'' : LState} : LRun k L L' → LStep k L' L'' → LRun k L L''

/-- `newArena` changes no kernel component (Part XIV, §76 `ok` effect: registering the entry
fabricates no place, access right or `Init` state). -/
theorem newArena_kernel {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} {L L' : LState}
    (h : NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L')) : L'.kern = L.kern := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl

/-- A guarded library step is a step without the guard (§56). -/
theorem LStep.ng {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') : LStepNG k L L' := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact .kernel hk
  | newArena hs => obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact .newArena hp.base
  | issue hs => exact .issue hs
  | reset hs => exact .reset hs

/-- Every library-reachable state is reachable without the guard (§56). -/
theorem LReach.ng {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : LState} (h : LReach k statics L) :
    LReachNG k statics L := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ hs ih => exact .step ih hs.ng

/-- The kernel part of a library step without the guard is reached by kernel steps (Part XIV,
§57: `newArena` changes no kernel component, `issue` is `split` then `store`, `reset` is `derive`
then `release`). -/
theorem LStepNG.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L L' : LState}
    (hr : Reachable k statics L.kern) (h : LStepNG k L L') : Reachable k statics L'.kern := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact .step hr hk
  | newArena _ => exact hr
  | issue hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
  | reset hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hd hrl _ => exact .step (.step hr (.derive hd)) (.release hrl)

/-- The kernel state of every library state reachable without the guard is kernel-reachable
(§57, Part XIV). -/
theorem LReachNG.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : LState}
    (h : LReachNG k statics L) : Reachable k statics L.kern := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ hs ih => exact hs.reachable ih

/-- `newArena_as_library` (Part XIV, §56, §57): registration changes no kernel component, and no
safety property of §57 depends on the guard of §56: every property of kernel-reachable states holds
for the kernel states of library runs with or without the guard. -/
theorem newArena_as_library (k : K) (statics : Statics) :
    (∀ (others : List (List Nat)) (st i : Nat) (L L' : LState),
      NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L') → L'.kern = L.kern) ∧
    (∀ L, LReach k statics L → LReachNG k statics L) ∧
    ∀ Q : S3 → Prop, (∀ s, Reachable k statics s → Q s) →
      ∀ L, LReachNG k statics L → Q L.kern :=
  ⟨fun _ _ _ _ _ h => newArena_kernel h, fun _ h => h.ng, fun _ hQ _ h => hQ _ h.reachable⟩

/-! ## Transport of `EntryInv` (§55) -/

/-- `s'` keeps the authorities of `s` (§42, §58): each keeps its mode and footprint, becomes
active only if it was, stays held by a place if it was, and keeps an origin `o` below it that is
active in `s'`. -/
def AKeep (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ j y, s.A[j]? = some y → ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧ y'.mode = y.mode ∧
theorem entryInv_append {s s' : S3} {E : ArenaEntry} {l : List Authority} (h : EntryInv s E)
    (hA : s'.A = s.A ++ l) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    (hlive : s'.Active E.internal) : EntryInv s' E :=
  entryInv_transport h (akeep_append hA) (fun _ => by rw [hP])
    ((S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).2 h.1.storageUsable) hlive

/-- A live entry registered by `newArena` satisfies `EntryInv`: `ArenaInv` by §76.6 (§55), and
`IssuedShape` since nothing is issued. -/
theorem newEntry_inv {s : S3} {st i : Nat} (h : NewArenaBase s st i) :
    EntryInv s ⟨st, i, footprint s.P st, []⟩ :=
  ⟨h.arenaInv, fun _ he => by cases he⟩

/-- `newArena` without the guard preserves the library invariant (§55, §76). -/
theorem lInv_newArena {L : LState} {st i : Nat} (h : NewArenaBase L.kern st i) (hi : LInv L) :
    LInv (newArenaEff L st i) := by
  intro F hF
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hF with hF | hF
  · exact hi F hF
  · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hF]
    have hia := h.internalAuth
    cases hy : L.kern.A[i]? with
    | none => rw [hy] at hia; exact hia.elim
    | some y => exact ⟨lt_of_getElem? hy, fun _ => newEntry_inv h⟩

/-- `issue` preserves the library invariant, for the issuing entry and every other entry (§55,
§77). -/
